adjudication.rationale: In `EmbeddableHost`, host normalization (stripping `http(s)://` and paths) is done in a `before_validation` callback (app/models/embeddable_host.rb). However the migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` inserts rows via raw SQL using the old `site_settings` value verbatim (`VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) without running validations/callbacks (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb). Since `record_for_host` parses the incoming URL and compares `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` against the stored column, any migrated rows that include a scheme or path (which the old setting/tests allowed, e.g. `http://discourse.org`, `https://example.com/1234`) will not match and will incorrectly be treated as disallowed.
